source: Calvo & Salgado 1995, Gaia 11, Fig. 18: cladogram of Rebbachisaurus tessonei among Sauropoda, a slanted cladogram from a poor-quality 1990s scan, small and low-resolution, with character numbers along the branches; 15 tips. Image: embedded image at native resolution (588x337 px), flipped vertically to match the page: the PDF stores it upside down and places it with a vertical-flip matrix, so a raw extraction is upside down.
gold_note: 15 tips, slanted cladogram from a low-resolution scan. All tip names are readable, so none were assigned by matrix order. PROSAUROPODA and TITANOSAURIDAE are collapsed terminals (triangles) and are matrix rows under those names. Matrix spellings: Haplocantosaurus (printed Haplocanthosaurus), Apatosaurus_lousiae. Each tip line was projected along its slope to the spine to confirm which node it joins.
